summary: Frontend Review Agent (Gate 8) reviewed PR #77 for NFR-REL-001 Auto-Save Crash Durability. Verdict: REQUEST_CHANGES. Found 2 blocking issues and 3 medium concerns. Blocking: (1) useAutoSave.ts passes hardcoded empty bricks [] instead of reading from sceneStore — auto-save will never persist actual user work; (2) package.json has unrelated breaking changes — removes immer, three-mesh-bvh, @vitest/coverage-v8, bumps zustand v4→v5 and vite v5→v6, removes useful scripts. Medium: (3) All test files use inline stubs instead of importing production code — zero coverage of actual implementation; (4) markSessionClosed() is async fire-and-forget in beforeunload — may not complete before page termination; (5) ResumePrompt lacks focus trap and Escape key handler for WCAG 2.1 AA. Architecture, idb usage, atomic transactions, validation, accessibility attributes, and data-testid alignment are all correct.

blocking_issues.title: useAutoSave passes hardcoded empty data — bricks never persisted
blocking_issues.description: triggerAutoSave() is called with bricks: [], hardcoded camera state, and placeholder metadata. Auto-save will always save an empty scene. E2E tests T-BE-REL-001-01 and T-BE-REL-001-02 will fail.
blocking_issues.fix: Read actual bricks from sceneStore (e.g., useSceneStore.getState().bricks) or accept a getter function as a hook parameter.

blocking_issues.title: Unrelated breaking changes in package.json
blocking_issues.description: Removes immer, three-mesh-bvh, @vitest/coverage-v8. Bumps zustand v4→v5 and vite v5→v6 (major versions). Removes lint:fix, format, format:check, type-check, test:e2e:ui scripts. Changes package name.
blocking_issues.fix: Revert package.json to original and only add idb (production), fake-indexeddb (devDependency), and globals (devDependency).

medium_concerns.title: Test files use inline stubs instead of real production imports
medium_concerns.description: All 4 test files define their own inline implementations rather than importing production code. Tests provide zero coverage of actual implementation.
medium_concerns.recommendation: Update test imports to use real production modules now that implementation exists.

medium_concerns.title: markSessionClosed() is async fire-and-forget in beforeunload
medium_concerns.description: Browser may terminate before IDB write completes. Many graceful closes may appear as crashes.
medium_concerns.recommendation: Consider synchronous localStorage fallback or navigator.sendBeacon pattern.

medium_concerns.title: Missing focus trap and Escape key handler
medium_concerns.description: Modal lacks keyboard accessibility features for WCAG 2.1 AA compliance.
medium_concerns.recommendation: Add focus trap, Escape key dismiss, and auto-focus on mount. Can be addressed in follow-up.

passed_checks: PersistenceError class with typed error codes
beforeunload listener with cleanup on unmount
All 10 test IDs from LLD Section 12 covered

human_review_required.item: Gate 8 — Blocking issues must be fixed before merge
human_review_required.reason: useAutoSave hardcoded data and package.json scope creep are blocking
Tests should import real production code for meaningful coverage

recommended_actions: Fix useAutoSave.ts to read actual scene state from sceneStore
Revert package.json to original, only add idb + fake-indexeddb + globals
Update test files to import real production modules
Consider adding focus trap to ResumePrompt (can be follow-up)
